guidance: Challenge vague assumptions. Converge on problem-solution fit, who it is for, how to validate, and what to cut from the first version. Prefer crisp statements over brainstorm dumps. Do not expand into a full PRD.

outline.title: Core Concept
outline.guidance: State the problem and proposed solution crisply.

children.title: Problem Statement
children.guidance: Exact user pain or inefficiency this idea targets.

children.title: Proposed Solution
children.guidance: Core insight and what makes the approach unique.

children.title: Persona
children.guidance: Title each instance with persona name or role, not "Persona".

children.title: Needs & Context
children.guidance: What this persona is trying to achieve and why it is urgent.

children.title: Current Workarounds
children.guidance: How they hack a solution today and where it breaks down.

outline.title: Validation Path
outline.guidance: Group experiments that will prove or kill the idea.

children.title: Experiment
children.guidance: Title each instance with the experiment name, not "Experiment".

children.title: Signal Needed
children.guidance: Qualitative or quantitative signal required to learn.

children.title: Success Threshold
children.guidance: Minimum result that justifies building further.

outline.title: MVP Scope
outline.guidance: Define what is cut from the first version.

children.title: Cutline
children.guidance: What is explicitly left out of the first version to validate faster.

outline.title: Open Risks
outline.guidance: Assumptions still in play. Wrapper is always present; omit risks when none.

children.title: Risk
children.guidance: Title each instance with the assumption or risk itself.

children.title: Why It Matters
children.guidance: What goes wrong if this is false.

children.title: How To De-risk
children.guidance: Signal, decision, or investigation that reduces uncertainty.
